# FeelFit 24

> FeelFit 24 is a 24/7 fitness gym in Block A, Satellite Town, Gujranwala, Pakistan. It offers separate training areas for men and women, personal training, fat loss, cardio fitness, strength building, weight training and CrossFit programs, with trainers Ali Khan, Sarah Malik and Ahmed Raza. Facilities include a posing room, ladies' makeup room, luxury bath and changing rooms, and a prayer space. First trial session is free.
